text: Brent closed at 92.14 USD/bbl on 11 November, up 2.2% from 90.16 USD/bbl the previous day, and 0.3% higher over the week. Egypt's bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December on 1 November, while on 28 September Genel Energy agreed to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn.
